blocks.h: Which water each product class needs
blocks.intro: Each product's legal class sets the minimum, in each market you sell to. One plant can make all four. Your specification may go higher, never lower.

blocks.h: Where water goes in a personal care plant
blocks.intro: One package supplies every point below. Most microbial problems start after the generator: in hoses, taps and sampling. The loop circulates and is sanitized on a schedule your results set.

items.d: The water phase of creams and lotions, and the base of shampoos, gels and rinse-offs
Tanks, fillers and hoses, and the cleaning rinse your procedure names
Glassware rinse and general use; reagent water follows your method's grade
Liquid soaps, detergents and cleaners made on the same site

blocks.h: From exchange DI to your own water
blocks.base: Your plant: drinking water, drain, power

items.d: A supplier swaps deionization (DI) tanks. Your plant gives a water feed and space; you test the outlet for microbes.
RO fills a tank you draw from, without a loop; configurations confirmed when you enquire. Needs drinking water, a drain and power.
Pretreatment, RO, DI or electrodeionization (EDI), storage and a loop to each point of use, with its records. Adds floor space.

items.a: No, not for a cosmetic-only product: your written specification sets the grade. Drug lines, with a Canadian DIN or sold in the US as OTC drugs, need PW under drug GMP. Natural health product lines start at potable water.
items.intent: I know my product, not my water spec|Cosmetics or personal care

items.q: Is polypropylene suitable for my product?
items.a: Yes, for an ambient loop sanitized with chemicals. Material certificates for everything that touches the water come with your documents.
French documentation is confirmed per project. Tell us which documents your operators, quality team and inspectors read in French.
